🎥🎬: Confession (2026)

Watch Confession on The Daily Wire.

In 1938 Moscow, Alexei, a former priest, is arrested and imprisoned at Lubyanka, where he discovers that his interrogator is Vladimir, a former student whose beliefs have been transformed by Stalin’s oppressive regime. Their reunion quickly becomes more than a political interrogation as the past begins to catch up with them.

As Vladimir pushes for answers, Alexei is forced to confront the relationship they once shared and the decisions that brought them to opposite sides of history. With fear and suspicion surrounding every conversation, both men must reckon with the consequences of their convictions.

Starring James Franco, Rob Lowe, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Kodi Smit-McPhee, Nick Nolte, and Emile Hirsch.
